name: Puls8
description: Above the street, the water stays warm and the lights stay low. Puls8 is a rooftop lounge and pool for late hours: dark colors, neon accents, and a pool that looks better after midnight. High enough to feel private. Rough enough that you do not have to behave.

events.title: PULS8 PRESENTS: CHRONICALLY ONLINE
events.blurb:
Touch grass? In this economy?

Your screen time is concerning. Your sleep schedule is fictional. Your algorithm knows you better than your own family.

And somehow, you still have time to serve a look. �

This Friday, log off from reality and log into Puls8 for a night dedicated to internet culture, viral bangers, questionable online behavior, and terminally online energy.

sync.note: We don't run a PlayerSync syncshell. Turn on ZoneSync instead and you'll sync with everyone in the club automatically.
